final_consolidated_verification: Deployed head and UI bundle both 7e7af573. Retention set to KEEP_DB=21 @ 02:45 through the operator API, confirmed in the config file, in systemd's OnCalendar, and in the sweep's own dry run, then restored to 7 @ 03:30. A PNG uploaded, served as image/png from the appliance's origin; an SVG refused; the asset directory answers 404 rather than an index. The portal serves a design carrying two languages and six Arabic keys, with eighteen tagged strings and the translation pass present. The login page carries Room Number, Use Personal Account, Voucher Code, Submit, Login, the pill and both account forms, and ZERO occurrences of the superseded wording. All seven services active; the only errors are the two standing ones.

a_latent_defect_the_deployment_surfaced.what: HOTEL_ADMIN_INTEGRITY failed with 'the RUNNING service serves BUILD_ID h_32... but the recorded live release is h-32...'. The bundle was correct.
a_latent_defect_the_deployment_surfaced.cause: .next/BUILD_ID holds Next's id verbatim while the id Next stamps into the rendered document has '-' rewritten to '_'. Every release until now generated an id containing no hyphen, so the difference had never appeared.
a_latent_defect_the_deployment_surfaced.the_drift_underneath: deploy-hotel-admin.sh already normalised for this, in-line at one call site. check-hotel-admin-integrity.sh -- which asks the identical question a moment later -- did not. Two implementations of one question, and only one of them knew.
a_latent_defect_the_deployment_surfaced.fixed: Both now call a single helper in the shared contract library. It normalises rather than relaxes: every other character must still match exactly. An identity check that cries wolf is worse than none, because the next real mismatch is the one nobody looks at.

guest_grace_observation: A 28,800-second grace entitlement appeared during this window, alongside eight at 3,600. That is not a defect: it is the eight-hour policy the Product Owner published through the new Checkout Grace screen being applied to a real departure. The feature working is what a second duration looks like.
what_closes_with_this: The consolidated Hotel Admin / Guest Portal mission. Checkout Grace history, Setup/Activation, the License and Cloud consolidation, System contrast and navigation, Backups as a real operator workflow with editable retention and schedule, config history, the guest portal redesigned to the reference screenshots with working translations and appliance-hosted images, and the branding designer with preview, versioning, rollback and a refusing advanced mode.
